MÁLAGA CF - R. RACING CLUB

LAROSALEDA | Saturday, November 7th, 2026, 14:00
Select the area

"AREA MOVILIDAD REDUCIDA" is exclusively for fans who require a wheelchair for access to the stadium. To purchase reduced mobility tickets, it is necessary to send an email to ticketing@malagacf.es

The tickets are personalized; upon purchase, the platform will request identification for each attendee corresponding to a ticket. Once the identification is completed, it will enable the download of the tickets in PDF format.
If you do not have a Spanish DNI or NIE, select the passport option to add your ID/Passport Number

Please be advised that the date and time specified for the match may be approximate and subject to changes, without the possibility of change or refund. Changes or refund are possible only in the event of the match suspension.

DYNAMIC PRICING – Prices may vary up until matchday.

The price shown includes a €2.50 fee.
